title: Independent source-and-report audit of 64 HT variants
scope: 64 unique option definitions; not 64 fully playable variants across all ammo and weapons
notClaimed: No direct review of newest repository JS or current test suite, no new live Foundry execution. Identified functionality reflects authored source reports.

P1_cartridge_loads.intent: cartridge load adjustments/individual matching/velocity and noise
P1_cartridge_loads.observations: Bulk work: already live +P, factory Match, Subsonic. Main unsolved: individually handloaded Match, silent captive-piston; expand confirmation per load rather than invent factory catalog records
P1_cartridge_loads.executionSuggestion: HT165/HT174; Action: extend evidence and handle GM handloading; do not reimplement +P.

P2_kinetic_projectiles.intent: shared HT166 numerical die conversion, AD, piercing and range
P2_kinetic_projectiles.observations: High reuse of common kinetic transform. Three DU options need proof of platform/load and incendiary-after-penetration behavior; HP has speed/Malf caveats. Existing AP/APHC/APDS/APFSDS/SAPFSDS/Frangible retained
P2_kinetic_projectiles.executionSuggestion: Candidate FIRST implementation packet: APDU, APDSDU, APFSDSDU + strict origin/guard for all 12. No blanket compatibility by caliber.

P3_multishot_nonlethal.intent: physical rounds vs multiple projectiles, shot dispersion, recoil, limited-velocity knockback
P3_multishot_nonlethal.observations: Partial native shotgun/slug/LeMat and B409 exist. Need separate launch and fragment path for shrapnel, beehive, ABF; not all 13 identical
P3_multishot_nonlethal.executionSuggestion: Recommended sub-batches: 1) slug, baton, beanbag, duplex/triplex; 2) pellet-count/projectile family; 3) bursting flechette.

P4_explosives.intent: kinetic + secondary explosion/fragmentation, shaped-charge and spall rules
P4_explosives.observations: APEX/APHEX live only for source-confirmed .50 and GM-approved AK; no universal blast stats. Other 11 not demonstrated; many need source-reported payload per individual munition
P4_explosives.executionSuggestion: Make common damage-component/Linked/Follow-Up support first. Group HE/LE/SAPHE separately from shaped-charge/tandem/spall and thermobaric.

P5_environment_payloads.intent: non-damage area effects, vision/chemical resistance, burn/smoke duration, contamination
P5_environment_payloads.observations: HT mechanics are described in source catalog, but no runtime scene/condition integrations confirmed in available reports
P5_environment_payloads.executionSuggestion: Begin with visual effects/conditions if supported; otherwise GM-mediated cards with explicit duration/range. Preserve real resistance and environment checks.

P6_fuses_tracer.intent: conditional firing/flight events and incendiary activation
P6_fuses_tracer.observations: Native `inc` preservation is NOT independent implementation of incendiary/tracer. Timing, visibility, fuse events not verified
P6_fuses_tracer.executionSuggestion: Single packet only after confirming hook for explosion scatter/hit and encounter timing.

P7_case_technology.intent: physical WPS/CPS and platform-specific feed/chamber acceptance
P7_case_technology.observations: Light cased 12G reference corrected; remaining light-case x0.7 and weapon-specific caseless/consumable chamber proving not demonstrated
P7_case_technology.executionSuggestion: Catalog can classify hard incompatible. Avoid automatic conversion/feeding from generic case labels.
